fact: 'The shoulder of the Centaur' — a nearby orange giant.
bio: Menkent (Theta Centauri) is an orange giant about 61 light-years away, one of the brighter stars of Centaurus and the only one of the constellation's leading lights that is a cool giant rather than a hot blue star.
cultural: The name means 'the shoulder of the Centaur'. Centaurus, home also to the Sun's nearest neighbours Alpha and Proxima Centauri, is one of the grandest figures of the southern sky.
